text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Haaah... The automatic door failed to 
detect me again, so Kris S-san took pity 
on me and opened it for me...

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Even at shops, the staff often don't 
notice I'm there... I wish I had a 
stronger presence...

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Ah, but Trainer-san, you always notice me 
and call out to me just like this, 
right...?

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
U-Um, what kind of landmark are you 
looking for? If we knew, it might give 
everyone else a clue to notice too...!
